id.description: Unique identifier of the seller service.

tags.description: The tags for this service. Empty if none were set.

price.description: USD as string. For priceModel: CUSTOM, use "0".

minimumTokenAmount.description: USD as string. For CUSTOM, use "0". Must be ≥ price after numeric conversion.

humanIdentityRequirement.description: The identity verification requirements for individuals, organizations, or both. See https://docs.skyfire.xyz/reference/identity-fields for more info.

identityLevels.description: Identity levels required from verified humans. e.g. `"INDIVIDUAL_LEVEL1"`.

organization.description: Values must be allowed identity field names.

individual.description: Values must be allowed identity field names.

mcpServerUrl.description: Required when `type` is MCP_SERVER_LOCAL or MCP_SERVER_REMOTE.

termsOfService.description: The details of the terms of service if they exist.

url.description: The URL where the terms of service are available to review.

required.description: `true` if acceptance of the terms of service is required.

acceptedTokens.description: Any of "kya", "pay", and/or "kya-pay". Must not be an empty array. If field is omitted, then all token types are accepted.

seller.description: The seller that owns this service.

identityLevel.description: Does not exist if the seller has not done verification.

createdAt.description: When the service was created. e.g. `"2025-07-18T02:51:54.265Z"`.

updatedAt.description: When the service was last updated. e.g. `"2025-07-18T02:54:19.767Z"`.

approved.description: Whether the service has been approved. Only approved services can be activated.
